mapper.insert: insert into structure_column (table_id, project_id, side, note_no, table_title, column_key, column_path, column_leaf, item_key, column_order, source_locator, created_at, updated_at) values (#{tableId}, #{projectId}, #{side}, #{noteNo}, #{tableTitle}, #{columnKey}, #{columnPath}, #{columnLeaf}, #{itemKey}, #{columnOrder}, #{sourceLocator}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: delete from structure_column where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side}
mapper.select: select * from structure_column where table_id = #{tableId} order by column_order, id
